name: agent-guardrails
description: A Claude Code plugin that stops coding agents from bypassing linters, skipping hooks, force pushing main and forgetting tests.
author: Chris Sanborn

scripts.build:check: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- dist)"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build:check && npm test
